title: DayOne
bottom_line: DayOne is no longer a GDS company: its 5 Oct 2026 F-1 lists Coatue and Hillhouse at 19.5% each, GDS at 19.4% after selling US$385 mn of shares back in Jan 2026, and Achi Capital at 15.6%. Its Batam business sits in PT DayOne Data Centers Indonesia, owned 60% by DayOne and 40% by Indonesia's sovereign fund INA, which also put money into DayOne itself in the Series C (most likely US$200 mn through PT Lestari Investasi Indonesia). Both campuses are on Citramas estates: the 72 MW Nongsa campus (let to "a leading U.S. hyperscaler", reportedly Oracle; structure built by Astra's Acset; financed by a Rp6.7 tn DBS/UOB loan) takes power through Tamarin's estate grid, while Kabil has its own 511 MVA PLN Batam contract for 360 MW of IT capacity, 240 MW of it already contracted and most likely for Firmus's NVIDIA AI factory.

entities.name: DayOne
entities.what: Singapore-headquartered data-centre developer spun out of GDS: incorporated in the Cayman Islands on 18 May 2022 as DigitalLand Holdings Limited, renamed DayOne on 1 Jan 2025. Filed an F-1 on 5 Oct 2026 for a Nasdaq IPO (ticker DODC). In Batam it has 72 MW in service, 240 MW under construction and 120 MW of secured powered land; Indonesia brought in US$59.4 mn of its US$484.3 mn revenue in 2025, and the F-1 cites Structure Research for a ~66% share of Batam bookings.

entities.name: DayOne Data Centers Singapore
entities.legal_name: DayOne Data Centers Singapore Pte. Ltd.
entities.what: DayOne's wholly owned Singapore holding company. It owns 60% of PT DayOne Data Centers Indonesia and 0.001% of each Digitalland PT, and it is the party that must buy out INA's 40% if INA uses its exchange right. Bloomberg names it as Oracle's partner.

entities.name: PT DayOne Data Centers Indonesia
entities.what: The Indonesian holding joint venture: DayOne Data Centers Singapore 60%, INA 40%. It owns 99.999% of PT Digitalland Services One and Two. Its shareholders' agreement was amended on 3 Jun 2026; INA put in US$82.5 mn in Apr-Jun 2026, matched pro rata by DayOne.

entities.name: PT Digitalland Services One
entities.what: DayOne's Indonesian company for the Kabil campus. It signed the 511 MVA PJBTL (17 Apr 2026) and the green-energy Head of Agreement (17 Aug 2026) with PLN Batam. PLN Batam and BP Batam spell it 'PT Digitalland Service One'. It sits in the slot of GDS's former PT GDS IDC Service (our reading of the One/Two names).

entities.name: PT Digitalland Services Two
entities.what: DayOne's significant Indonesian subsidiary (F-1 Exhibit 21.1). In 2025 it was granted a 100% corporate income tax cut for 20 years from the year commercial production starts. The F-1 does not say which campus it holds. It sits in the slot of GDS's former PT GDS IDC Services Two (our reading).

entities.name: PT GDS IDC Service
entities.what: GDS-era Indonesian company, listed as a GDS subsidiary in GDS's 20-F for FY2022 and FY2023 alongside PT GDS IDC Services Two. It was Acset's client for 'GDS Data Center Nongsa' phases I-II (Katadata, Jul 2023: 40 MW Tier 3 in two phases, 28,730 m2, Rp4 tn). The name is absent from DayOne's 2026 structure chart, so it was most likely renamed (our reading).

entities.name: DayOne Nongsa Digital Park (NDP)
entities.what: DayOne's first Batam campus, in KEK Nongsa: 72 MW in service. Per the F-1, it was delivered to 'a leading U.S. hyperscaler' whose first 34 MW was later upsized to 72 MW. Three buildings, 68,812 m2 GFA, LEED Gold for building NDP C, on leasehold (HGB) land. It started as a 28 MW plan at DayOne's Jul 2022 groundbreaking, when DayOne was still GDS's international arm, and was financed by the Rp6.7 tn DBS/UOB loan. Status: operating.

entities.name: DayOne Kabil Industrial Tech Park (KITP)
entities.what: DayOne's second Batam campus, inside Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate. It has 360 MW of IT power capacity: 240 MW contracted to 'a leading technology company' and under construction, plus 120 MW of secured powered land (F-1). Grid supply is a PLN Batam PJBTL of about 511 MVA (~450 MW), delivered in phases in 2026-2027. Status: under construction.

entities.name: Firmus NVIDIA DSX AI Factory, Batam
entities.what: Planned 360 MW AI factory (IT or facility basis not stated) for up to 170,000 NVIDIA accelerators in 2027-2028, developed with DayOne. PLN Batam gives a Q1 2027 operating target, and BTW Media places it at Kabil Tech Park. Status: announced.

entities.name: GDS Holdings
entities.what: Nasdaq- and HKEX-listed Chinese data-centre operator. It is DayOne's former parent and now its third-largest shareholder, with 19.4%.

entities.name: Coatue
entities.legal_name: Coatue Tactical Solutions PS Holdings AIV 11 LP / AIV 12 LP; Coatue PC LLC
entities.what: US investment firm. It led DayOne's Series C and holds 19.5% as converted; its vehicles are registered in Wilmington, Delaware.

entities.name: Hillhouse
entities.legal_name: Hillhouse Investment Management, Ltd. (HGDC, HGDK, HGDO II, HBYT Co-Investment Holdings)
entities.what: Asian investment firm. It invested in all three DayOne rounds and holds 19.5%. The shares held by HGDC, HGDK and HGDO II are pledged to lenders (F-1).

entities.name: Achi Capital
entities.legal_name: AchiCapital GP Limited (Achi Capital Partners Fund LP)
entities.what: Investment firm controlled by Timothy Chu-Wan Chen. It invested in all three rounds through Luminous Knowledge, Grand Slam, Prosperis Holding and Nocturne Rise, and holds 15.6% of DayOne.

entities.name: Baupost
entities.legal_name: Baupost Private Investments A-2, B-2, C-2, BVI-2, BVII-2, BVIII-2 and BVIV-2, L.L.C.
entities.what: US investor. It put US$150 mn into Series B and about US$168 mn into Series C, roughly 4.1% as converted (our arithmetic from the F-1).

entities.name: Princeville Global
entities.legal_name: Princeville Global Datacenter Development Investments Limited; Princeville Global III ANZ Fund
entities.what: Investor in all three rounds, US$154.4 mn in total, about 2.2% as converted (our arithmetic).

entities.name: SVF II Atlantic (SoftBank Vision Fund 2)
entities.what: Bought US$50 mn of Series B on 31 Dec 2024. 'SVF II' is SoftBank Vision Fund 2's naming, so the SoftBank link is our reading.

entities.name: Alpha JWC Ventures
entities.legal_name: Alpha JWC Ventures III, L.P.; PT AJWCS Sinergi Tiga
entities.what: Indonesia-focused early- to growth-stage investment firm founded in 2015 (its site). It put US$34.2 mn into DayOne's Series B and C.

entities.name: PT Lestari Investasi Indonesia
entities.what: Indonesian vehicle that bought US$200 mn of DayOne Series C on 31 Dec 2025 (about 1.7% as converted). Its president director, Andry Setiawan, was INA's co-CIO, so it is most likely INA's vehicle (our reading).

entities.name: INA (Indonesia Investment Authority)
entities.what: Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund. It has been DayOne's 40% partner in the Indonesian JV since 2023, joined DayOne's Series C at group level (Jan 2026), and lent to DayOne in 2024-2025.

entities.name: DBS
entities.what: Singapore bank. With UOB, it provided the Rp6.7 tn (SGD 530 mn) loan for DayOne's Nongsa campus (Jun 2025).

entities.name: UOB (United Overseas Bank)
entities.what: Singapore bank. With DBS, it provided the Rp6.7 tn (SGD 530 mn) loan for DayOne's Nongsa campus (Jun 2025).

entities.name: Morgan Stanley
entities.what: IPO underwriter for DayOne's proposed Nasdaq listing (Oct 2026).

entities.name: J.P. Morgan
entities.what: IPO underwriter for DayOne's proposed Nasdaq listing (Oct 2026).

entities.name: BofA Securities
entities.what: IPO underwriter for DayOne's proposed Nasdaq listing (Oct 2026).

entities.name: Citigroup
entities.what: IPO underwriter for DayOne's proposed Nasdaq listing (Oct 2026).

entities.name: Oracle
entities.what: US cloud company. Bloomberg (Jul 2025, unnamed sources) reported it would lease DayOne's Nongsa Digital Park data centres as sole tenant of plots for at least 120 MW. Oracle has not confirmed.

entities.name: ByteDance
entities.what: TikTok owner. It is DayOne's largest customer group-wide (69.4% of 2025 revenue, described but not named in the F-1; Bloomberg names it). We found no source placing it in Batam.

entities.name: Firmus Technologies
entities.what: Australian AI-factory company that PLN Batam describes as NVIDIA-backed. It is building a 360 MW NVIDIA DSX campus in Batam with DayOne. By Sep 2026 it listed seven AI factories in Australia, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia.

entities.name: NVIDIA
entities.what: Chipmaker supplying up to 170,000 accelerators and its DSX AI-factory platform for Firmus' Batam campus, under a partnership that runs to 2034.

entities.name: Benmax
entities.what: Designs and makes Firmus' HyperCube liquid-cooled modules in regional NSW. Firmus agreed on 13 Aug 2026 to buy Benmax's fabrication, design and projects businesses for A$300 mn.

entities.name: PLN Batam
entities.what: Batam's electricity utility and a PLN subsidiary. It supplies DayOne Kabil (511 MVA PJBTL) and the Nongsa estate grid run by Tamarin.

entities.name: PLN
entities.what: State electricity company and parent of PLN Batam.

entities.name: Maxpower Indonesia
entities.what: Gas-engine power producer named by Tamarin (2022) as the second power source for the KEK Nongsa estate grid.

entities.name: Tamarin (Nongsa Digital Park)
entities.what: Citramas subsidiary that develops and manages KEK Nongsa / Nongsa Digital Park (166.45 ha under Government Regulation 68/2021; Citramas gives NDP as 188.04 ha). It buys power from PLN Batam and Maxpower and distributes it to NDP data centres over its own grid. Its PJBTL rose from 389 to 1,064 MVA in Dec 2024.

entities.name: Citramas Group
entities.what: Batam group chaired by Kris Wiluan. It owns Nongsa Digital Park (through Tamarin) and Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate, the estates that host both DayOne campuses.

entities.name: Kabil Integrated Industrial Estate (KIIE)
entities.legal_name: PT Kabil Indonusa Estate; PT Kabil Citranusa
entities.what: Citramas' 538 ha industrial estate on Batam's east coast, run through PT Kabil Indonusa Estate and PT Kabil Citranusa. It hosts DayOne KITP.

entities.name: BP Batam
entities.legal_name: Badan Pengusahaan Kawasan Perdagangan Bebas dan Pelabuhan Bebas Batam
entities.what: Batam Free Trade Zone authority. It hosted the DayOne-PLN Batam PJBTL signing, handles licensing, and requires data centres in Nongsa and Kabil to desalinate their own water.

entities.name: Dewan Nasional KEK (National SEZ Council)
entities.what: National council for Special Economic Zones. KEK Nongsa was set up by Government Regulation 68/2021 (signed 8 Jun 2021, 166.45 ha), and the council named Tamarin its developer-manager (decree 2/2021).

entities.name: USGBC (LEED)
entities.what: Green-building body behind LEED. DayOne lists LEED Gold for building NDP C.

entities.name: Acset
entities.what: Astra-group contractor, 91.17% held by PT Karya Supra Perkasa. It built the structure of 'GDS Data Center Nongsa' phases I-II.

entities.name: STT GDC (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
entities.what: Singapore data-centre group. Its STT Group entities hold a minority stake in GDS (F-1). DayOne's chairman Lim Ah Doo was a director there.

entities.name: Jamie Khoo
entities.what: DayOne CEO since 2024 and director since 2026. Earlier about a decade at GDS as Deputy CFO, then COO, and senior finance roles at ST Telemedia, ABB, EY and Baker Hughes.

entities.name: William Wei Huang
entities.what: Chairman of GDS and its CEO since 2002. DayOne director since 2022 (Chairman and CEO in 2022 releases). Under the shareholders' deed he can name one post-IPO director.

entities.name: Lim Ah Doo
entities.what: DayOne chairman since Apr 2026 and director since 2024. Former director of STT GDC and ST Telemedia; chairman of Olam Group until Apr 2026; earlier chairman of Morgan Grenfell (Asia).

entities.name: Andy (Satoshi) Okada
entities.what: DayOne director since 2023. President of a SoftBank-Alibaba joint venture and President and CEO of Alibaba Japan; earlier a SoftBank Japan executive.

entities.name: Nicolás Aguzín
entities.what: DayOne director since 2026. CEO of HKEX 2021-2024, earlier at J.P. Morgan; director of MercadoLibre, Globant and Pampa Energia; founder of Aguave Capital.

entities.name: Timothy Chu-Wan Chen
entities.what: DayOne director since 2026. Partner of Achi Capital since 2022 and controlling shareholder of AchiCapital GP; earlier CEO of VIA China.

entities.name: Douglas Farrell
entities.what: DayOne director since 2026. Founder and managing partner of Quintet Partners (2016); earlier deputy CEO of Vinhomes and head of M&A, Australia and NZ, at Citigroup.

entities.name: Bob McCooey
entities.what: Vice Chairman of Nasdaq. DayOne board advisor since 2024; becomes a director when the F-1 takes effect.

entities.name: Yan Chengkang (CK)
entities.what: DayOne CFO since Mar 2026. At Hillhouse 2023-2026 (a Managing Director, per DayOne's site), KKR 2013-2022 and Citi 2009-2013.

entities.name: Daniel Fertig
entities.what: DayOne Chief Legal Officer since Jun 2026; previously a capital-markets partner at Simpson Thacher & Bartlett.

entities.name: Philippe Laffont
entities.what: Managing member of Coatue Structured Fund GP LLC and of Coatue PC LLC, the entities behind Coatue's DayOne shares.

entities.name: Lei Zhang
entities.what: May be deemed to control Hillhouse Investment Management, the manager of the Hillhouse funds holding DayOne shares (F-1; he disclaims beneficial ownership).

entities.name: Ridha Wirakusumah
entities.what: INA CEO until 15 Feb 2026. He signed the DayOne joint venture in 2023 and was quoted on the Series C in Jan 2026.

entities.name: Andry Setiawan
entities.what: INA managing director of investments from 2021, co-CIO from Jun 2025, resigned Feb 2026 (Bloomberg via Asia Asset). President Director of PT Lestari Investasi Indonesia (Dec 2025). Earlier director of investment at PT Danareksa.

entities.name: Johan Batubara
entities.what: INA Director of Investments, quoted on the DayOne Batam project in Jul 2025.

entities.name: Kwin Fo
entities.what: President Director (Direktur Utama) of PT PLN Batam in 2026; spoke at the DayOne PJBTL and the Firmus welcome.

entities.name: Amsakar Achmad
entities.what: Head of BP Batam and Mayor of Batam. He spoke at the DayOne PJBTL signing (Apr 2026) and on DayOne's desalination plan (Sep 2026).

entities.name: Li Claudia Chandra
entities.what: Deputy Head of BP Batam and Deputy Mayor of Batam; welcomed the Firmus-NVIDIA-DayOne project (Jun 2026).

entities.name: Kris Wiluan
entities.what: Chairman of Citramas Group. He attended DayOne's NDP groundbreaking (Jul 2022) and GDS's piling ceremony (Oct 2022).

entities.name: Michael Kristian (Mike) Wiluan
entities.what: President Director of PT Tamarin, who signed its 2022 power MoU with PLN Batam; CEO of Nongsa Digital Park in 2022.

entities.name: Ken Miyauchi
entities.what: DayOne board advisor since 2024; board director of SoftBank Group Corp and former President and CEO of SoftBank Corp.

links.detail: Water: BP Batam makes Nongsa and Kabil data centres build their own seawater desalination. DayOne is preparing a ~Rp180 bn SWRO plant to hand over to BP Batam (Sep 2026); the reports name no campus, but a 23 Sep 2026 report calls DayOne the one operating facility that responded. The F-1 notes late-Sep 2026 protests near NDP over local water shortages.
links.quote: DayOne bahkan menyiapkan SWRO senilai sekitar Rp180 miliar yang nantinya diserahkan kepada BP Batam.
